source_note: 利用连续函数的identity theorem证明函数方程
english_source_note: Functional Equations via the Identity Theorem
callout_id: 利用连续函数的identity theorem证明函数方程#1
statement_en: Assume $f,g$ are both continuous maps from $\mathbb{R}$ to some Hausdorff topological space $Y$. If $$f(r)=g(r),\forall r \in \mathbb{Q}$$ then $$f(x)=g(x),\forall x \in \mathbb{R}.$$
key_techniques: density of the rational numbers in $\mathbb{R}$
continuity and uniqueness from a dense subset
callout_body: 假设$f,g$都是由$\mathbb{R}$到某个Hausdroff的拓扑空间$Y$的连续映射，如果$$f(r)=g(r),\forall r \in \mathbb{Q}$$那么$$f(x)=g(x),\forall x \in \mathbb{R}$$
